requirements.text: GET api-part-category-list without filter parameters returns HTTP 200 with eight categories.
GET api-part-category-list with parent=1 and cascade=false returns HTTP 200 with three direct child categories.

GET api-part-category-list with cascade=true and depth=0, without parent, returns HTTP 200 with two top-level categories.
GET api-part-category-list with parent=1, cascade=true, and depth=0 returns HTTP 200 with an empty category list.
GET api-part-category-list with parent=1, cascade=true, and depth=2 returns HTTP 200 with five categories within the requested relative depth.
